g.text: 1. Function: RK3566 supply units and their decoupling, grouped by rail in placement order

g.desc: 1. Function: RK3566 supply units and their decoupling, grouped by rail in placement order

g.text: (smallest value nearest the balls). Values: RK3566 HDG 1.1 pp. 32-41, as in the rail table.

g.desc: (smallest value nearest the balls). Values: RK3566 HDG 1.1 pp. 32-41, as in the rail table.

g.text: 2. Absent state: not applicable (the SoC is never omitted).

g.desc: 2. Absent state: not applicable (the SoC is never omitted).

g.text: 3. The capacitors of vdd_cpu, vdd_logic, vdd_gpu, vdd_npu and the DDR rails go on the back,

g.desc: 3. The capacitors of vdd_cpu, vdd_logic, vdd_gpu, vdd_npu and the DDR rails go on the back,

g.text: under the SoC, ground pads solid (HDG pp. 36-40, 92-93). None may be removed (HDG).

g.desc: under the SoC, ground pads solid (HDG pp. 36-40, 92-93). None may be removed (HDG).

g.text: 4. vdd_logic link R: H5 5 mΩ in every variant (BOM v1 line 137); FB1 of the RK809 senses

g.desc: 4. vdd_logic link R: H5 5 mΩ in every variant (BOM v1 line 137); FB1 of the RK809 senses

g.text: vdd_logic on its load side, so the drop is regulated out (power tree §4.12).

g.desc: vdd_logic on its load side, so the drop is regulated out (power tree §4.12).

g.text: 5. PHY analog supplies (vdda_0v9 PHY balls, USB 3.3 V) have no value in the HDG transcription:

g.desc: 5. PHY analog supplies (vdda_0v9 PHY balls, USB 3.3 V) have no value in the HDG transcription:

g.text: their decoupling is open (UNVERIFIED) until RK3566_PinOut and HDG Fig. 2-22 are read.

g.desc: their decoupling is open (UNVERIFIED) until RK3566_PinOut and HDG Fig. 2-22 are read.

g.text: 6. Unless noted: capacitors X5R/X7R, rated at least twice the rail.

g.desc: 6. Unless noted: capacitors X5R/X7R, rated at least twice the rail.
